parse.title: Underground Pass
parse.wikitext:
==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[King Lathas]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Ardougne Castle]].
|startmap = 2577,3293,plane:1
|difficulty = Experienced
|description = There are rumours of a secret passageway that can be used to get to the other side of the mountains west of Ardougne. Now it's just a matter of finding it.
|length = Long
|requirements = * {{SCP|Ranged|25|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}}
* Completion of the following quests:
** [[Biohazard]]
*** [[Plague City]]
|items = * [[Rope]] (2 recommended)
* [[Bow]]
* 1-5 [[arrows]] (only non-poisoned arrows with metal [[arrowtips]] will work. [[Craw's bow]] does not work. Crossbows and bolts will not work. Broad arrows,  Ogre arrows, Ice arrows, and Training Arrows will also not work.)
* [[Spade]]
* [[Bucket]] (obtainable during quest)
* [[Tinderbox]] (obtainable during quest)
|recommended = * [[Plank]] (obtainable during quest)
* {{SCP|Combat|60|link=yes}}
* {{SCP|Agility|50+|link=yes}} to reduce the risk of failing obstacles.
* {{SCP|Thieving|50|link=yes}} for a helpful shortcut.
* [[Weapon]] or [[combat spells]]. Using the bow is recommended if you need to save inventory space.
* [[Armour]] or {{SCP|Prayer|43|link=yes}} for [[Protect from Melee]].
* ''Lots'' of [[food]] to survive traps and monsters. Taking a few [[Summer Pie]]s is highly recommended if under 60 [[Agility]], as eating these heals 22 in two bites and boosts your agility level by 5 per bite. Alternatively, [[Saradomin brew]]s or [[super restore]]s to reduce weight.
** Coins to buy food from [[Kamen]] (75 coins each time for food that heals a total of 28 hitpoints).
** Bones to peaches magic tablets (as there are weak mobs that can be killed for bones when you need food)
* [[West Ardougne Teleport]] to quickly access the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)]] entrance.
* Level 79 combat will make [[Blessed spider]]s non-aggressive, which saves some time while killing [[Kalrag]].
* An [[explorer's ring]] and [[stamina potion|stamina]] or [[energy potions]]
* 2+ [[Agility potion]]s if not taking [[summer pies]] (for players with a low [[Agility]] level).
* [[Telekinetic Grab]] runes for the [[Amulet of othanian]]
* Any instant [[Transportation#Teleportation|teleportation]] method if you need to leave the dungeon
|kills = * 3 demons [[Doomion]], [[Othainian]], and [[Holthion]] ''(level 91)'' (easily [[safespot]]table)
* 3 [[Paladin]]s ''(level 62)'' (easily [[safespot]]table)
* [[Kalrag]] ''(level 89)'' ([[safespot]]table) (won't hit with [[Protect from Melee]])
* [[Disciple of Iban]] ''(level 13)''
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Tirannwn}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}
